For N=1, A=y=1, x_0=0, step eta, and B(v)=v restricted to v=0, the identity graph has tangent 1 at eta=0 although the deployed map is defined only there. The repair supplies arbitrary tau>1 in the Example and Given clause, states the exact residual test in F1, and verifies its failure even at N.
